note: Dates when a key or account needs renewing. Names only, never the key itself. The weekly health report warns 45 days ahead.

items.name: GitLab backup token (mirror job)
items.how: GitLab > Preferences > Access tokens: make a new one, then GitHub > Settings > Secrets > update the mirror secret

items.name: Owner's GitHub key in the phone app (Approve/Skip)
items.how: github.com > Settings > Developer settings > Fine-grained tokens: regenerate, then paste in the app's Settings
